channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iranophobia: Netanyahu’s bid to transform fear into political survival
item.description: Despite knowing a war with Iran would be manufactured for Netanyahu's survival, many would still rally behind it.

item.title: Iran says it targeted US radar site in Bahrain
item.description: IRGC says it hit radar in retaliation for an 'enemy' air attack on a telecom tower in Iran's Hormozgan province.

item.title: Gaza surgeon films aftermath of Israeli strike
item.description: British volunteer surgeon films the terrifying aftermath of an Israeli strike on Gaza’s Nasser Hospital.

item.title: Finland detects strike on Russian warship as Zelenskyy meets US envoys
item.description: Reports of attack in Baltic came before US envoys met with Russian and Ukrainian presidents.

item.title: After Iraq ex-MP’s killing, Lebanon asks Syria to extradite suspects
item.description: Longtime Sunni politician and Iran critic was reportedly strangled in Beirut, sparking investigation.

item.title: Albania’s PM says 2027 NATO summit will not be held in Tirana
item.description: Albania has faced criticism over low defence spending, as Rama is under pressure at home amid months of protests.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump says Gulf allies urged pause in Iran strikes
item.description: Trump says Gulf countries asked him to hold off on further attacks against Iran as Tehran targets US radar in Bahrain.

item.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says
item.description: Witnesses say a missile hit a building containing the surgical wards and intensive care units at Nasser hospital, the largest in southern Gaza.

item.title: Eight killed in Colombian air strike targeting Gulf Clan gang
item.description: A suspected gang leader considered a "priority target" was among those killed, the Colombian president says.

item.title: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated after alleged Iranian threats
item.description: Bessent is now one of several Trump administration officials to live on military bases due to safety concerns.
